items.logic: Upon selection, sets local React state for Temporal boundaries normalized to exact UTC 00:00:00Z. For 'Monthly', the boundary is strictly Day 1 00:00:00Z to Last Day 23:59:59Z UTC.
items.behavior: Triggers asynchronous refetch to GET /api/v1/dashboard/metrics without page reload. Caches last selected toggle in LocalStorage.

items.state_validation: Must evaluate active Time-Slice Toggle. IF (BoundarySpan > 365 Days) THEN set `disabled=true` and display tooltip 'Export limited to 12-month span'.
items.execution_logic: ON_CLICK: Triggers POST /api/v1/dashboard/export/pdf payload with current query parameters. UI visually transitions to disabled/loading state until the 24-hour expiration token/URI is returned from AWS S3, or gracefully catches HTTP 429 Too Many Requests if user spam clicks.

items.format_rule: Strictly format string to US Locale Currency format: `$#,##0.00`.
items.data_source_logic: Aggregates `booked_revenue` from the metrics payload matching the user's explicit RBAC territory permissions.

items.visual_state: IF Growth > 0 THEN Color=Green, Icon=ArrowUp. IF Growth < 0 THEN Color=Red, Icon=ArrowDown.
items.math_formula: Calculates (Current Pacing / Historical Calendar Equivalent). E.g. If today is April 5, compares April 1-5 Revenue against strictly March 1-5 Revenue.

items.x_axis_formatting: Localized formatting String `YYYY-MM-DD` mapping directly to the underlying UTC datapoint to ensure global visual consistency.
items.tooltip_behavior: Hovering over a node MUST display isolated Date (YYYY-MM-DD) and increment revenue amount. No interpolations for missing dates.

items.authorization: Requires Bearer JWT. Header must contain Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) payload to partition Mongo query.
items.caching_strategy: System queries Redis First. IF Redis is OOM/Crashed (Failover Degradation), bypass cache and query MongoDB directly using Field-Level decryption.
items.error_handling: If failover engaged and latency exceeds 5s, append header `X-Performance-Degraded: true` to trigger UI warning banner.

items.protocol: Server-Sent Events (SSE). Pushes cache invalidation flags.
items.thundering_herd_prevention: Backend MUST stagger outgoing SSE push events randomly across a 0-2000 millisecond jitter specifically to prevent 10,000 active clients from simultaneously HTTP polling right after the DB syncs.
items.client_recovery: If WebSocket / SSE pipeline silently drops, React client must fall back to HTTP Polling every 30 seconds.

items.architecture_constraint: Must run on isolated asynchronous Puppeteer Worker Node (node:alpine) to protect main NestJS event loop.
items.validation_rule: REJECT with HTTP 400 Bad Request IF date parameters > 365 Days.
items.s3_retention_policy: Node service must configure `Expires` property on AWS S3 PutObject to automatically drop file 24 hours after creation. Returns pre-signed URL.

items.hard_delete_sync_logic: Must poll source CRM for `updated_at > last_sync`. Must ALSO cross-reference deleted CRM Node IDs to hard delete ghost records in Read MongoDB.
items.revenue_attribution_lock: KPI attribution is permanently locked to the Sales Rep ID assigned at the precise millisecond the timestamp closed, surviving any future CRM transfer re-assignments.
